# Comb Hair Combs Set for Women and Men: 6-Piece Wide and Fine Tooth Assortment

## Styling Tools for Every Hair Type

Equip your routine with six soft, flexible plastic combs in assorted designs. Wide-tooth and fine-tooth options work across curly, straight, and long hair, so you can detangle, part, and style with the right comb for each job.

## Smooth Edges for Gentle Brushing

Smooth-edged combs glide through hair with less tugging, making brushing more comfortable for your hands and scalp. The flexible construction resists easy breakage, so each comb holds up through daily use.

## Pocket-Sized for Travel and Everyday Carry

Each comb is small enough to slip into a pocket, purse, or carry-on. Keep one nearby for quick touch-ups at work, on the road, or during vacations.

## Versatile for Home, Salon, and Gifting

Use these combs for personal grooming or for barbershop and salon work like dressing, parting, and cutting. The bright, mixed colors suit women, men, children, and adults, making this set a practical, budget-friendly gift for birthdays, holidays, and Valentine's Day.

## Add Your Set to Cart

Get six styling combs for $4.95 and keep the right tool ready wherever your day takes you.
